title: The Seraphinite Accelerator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Seraphinite Accelerator WordPress plugin up to version 2.31 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the HTTP_USER_AGENT parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts. Exploitation requires that an administrator has enabled both 'Enable logging' and 'HTTP trace' diagnostic options, which are disabled by default.
